title: 订单状态分布
query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：统计2026年8月1日至22日下单的订单，按订单状态统计订单数，不额外筛选实付金额。
reason: 结果数值和维度匹配（忽略别名、列顺序、行顺序）

result.sql: SELECT orders.order_status AS "订单状态", COUNT(orders.order_id) AS "订单数量" FROM orders WHERE orders.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND orders.ordered_at <= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-22 23:59:59' GROUP BY orders.order_status ORDER BY "订单数量" DESC
